decision: S2: added headless dataset-writer/LBPH-train/recognizer round-trip tests (tests/test_facialrecognition_pipeline.py, 6 new tests) that the prior S1 cycle flagged as missing despite tests_passing already exceeding threshold. Tests use a stub camera and stub CascadeClassifier detector (real Haar detection already covered by the S1 smoke suite) with deterministic per-identity synthetic textures so LBPH train/predict correctness is exercised without needing a bundled photo gallery: capture_faces() writes dataset files from stubbed frames and asserts exact filenames/count; train_recognizer() trains on a small synthetic dataset and writes trainer.yml; load_recognizer()+recognize_face() correctly label held-out crops (sample index 99, never in the training set) by identity, plus an unknown-confidence-threshold case. train_recognizer() gained an optional detector= parameter (default unchanged: build_face_detector()) purely to allow the stub injection. Candidates weighed: (a) this S2 round-trip coverage vs (b) starting S3's bundled fixture gallery for the accuracy floor -- deferred (b) since it needs sourced/licensed face images and a disjoint train/held-out split, a larger scope better run as its own cycle once S2's test scaffolding (this change) exists to build on.
